grammar.concept: Present Simple & Habitual Actions (Hiện tại đơn & Thói quen công sở)
grammar.trap: Bẫy chia động từ số ít/số nhiều theo chủ ngữ tập hợp (department, committee, board).

vocab.example: Both parties agreed to abide by the judge’s decision.
According to the agreement, the caterer will also supply the flowers.
The sales rep gave his assurance that the missing parts would be replaced.
Work on the project came to a halt with the cancellation of funding.
After reading the contract, I was still unable to determine if our company was liable.
Before engaging in a new business, it is valid to research that market.
The merger has established a powerful new company in the computer industry.
The contractor was obligated by the contract to complete the work by April.
The parties agreed to a settlement in their contract dispute.
The contract contains a provision to deal with how payments are made.

questions.text: The two parties were unable to reach an ------- on the terms of payment.
All employees are required to abide ------- company safety rules.
The warranty provides ------- that defective equipment will be replaced.

grammar.concept: Present Continuous vs. Present Simple (Hiện tại tiếp diễn vs Hiện tại đơn)
grammar.trap: Động từ chỉ trạng thái (stative verbs: belong, know, understand) KHÔNG chia tiếp diễn.

vocab.example: The mediator was able to resolve the problem to everyone’s satisfaction.
The customer’s specific request was not readily available.
The new advertising campaign attracted many new clients.
The survey compared the prices of two similar computers.
We cannot compete with their rock-bottom prices.
The software consumes a lot of memory.
He convinced us that the project was on schedule.
Currently, the company is expanding its operations in Asia.
The mini-dress was a fad that only lasted a season.
His work is an inspiration to the entire marketing team.

questions.text: The company is currently ------- into new international markets.
The firm ------- money this quarter due to supply chain disruption.
questions.expl: Cần thì tiếp diễn: is losing money (chỉ biến động tạm thời trong quý này).

grammar.concept: Compound Nouns & Word Forms (Danh từ ghép & Vị trí danh từ sau tính từ)
grammar.trap: Danh từ đứng đầu câu làm chủ ngữ cần chú ý mạo từ và tính từ bổ nghĩa.

vocab.meaning: tiếp thị, đưa ra thị trường
vocab.example: The company markets its products aggressively online.
It took a lot of persuasion to get the board to approve the budget.
The morning meeting was highly productive.
Customer satisfaction is our top priority.
Patience is a key characteristic of a great manager.
As a consequence of the strike, production ceased.
We are considering an external consultant.
The policy covers medical and travel expenses.
Check the expiration date on the software license.
Appliances frequently come with a one-year warranty.

questions.text: Our department is currently ------- a new policy for remote work.
questions.expl: Hành động tạm thời diễn ra thời gian này dùng is considering.

questions.text: Please check the ------- date stamped on the package.
questions.expl: Danh từ ghép chuẩn: expiration date (ngày hết hạn).

grammar.concept: Gerunds after Prepositions (Danh động từ V-ing sau giới từ)
grammar.trap: Sau giới từ (of, for, in, about, with) động từ LUÔN ở dạng V-ing.

vocab.example: The memo implied that changes would be made soon.
The research shows great promise.
A patent protects the company against unauthorized copying.
The firm has built a solid reputation for quality.
The law requires companies to file financial statements.
The store carries a variety of electronic goods.
The CEO will address shareholder concerns tomorrow.
Careful planning will help avoid costly errors.
The test demonstrated that the device is waterproof.
They are developing a new marketing strategy.

questions.text: The marketing team is ------- the new packaging this week.
questions.expl: Hành động đang diễn ra trong tuần này dùng is evaluating.

questions.text: This trademark ------- to our subsidiary in Singapore.
questions.expl: Động từ belong chỉ sở hữu, không dùng tiếp diễn ➔ belongs to.

grammar.concept: Modal Verbs (Động từ khiếm khuyết: must, should, can, will)
grammar.trap: Sau modal verb bắt buộc là Bare Infinitive (Động từ nguyên mẫu không to).

vocab.example: Managers must evaluate employee performance yearly.
We gathered data from thousands of users.
The company accepted an attractive takeover offer.
The report is primarily concerned with domestic sales.
Investing abroad carries high financial risk.
Our long-term strategy focuses on sustainability.
The company posted strong quarterly profits.
You can substitute olive oil for butter in the recipe.
The auditorium can accommodate up to 500 guests.
We made special arrangements for travel.

questions.text: All department heads must ------- their annual budgets by Friday.
The firm will accommodate ------- requests whenever possible.

grammar.concept: Past Continuous with While/When (Quá khứ tiếp diễn với While/When)
grammar.trap: Hành động đang xảy ra (chia quá khứ tiếp diễn) thì hành động khác xen vào (quá khứ đơn).

vocab.example: She is a member of the American Bar Association.
Over 200 managers attended the annual conference.
Please get in touch with our HR department.
The seminar will be held on the third floor.
The company is seeking a prime location downtown.
The trade show floor was extremely overcrowded.
Participants must register before October 15.
The committee selected three final candidates.
The morning training session begins at 9:00 AM.
All employees are invited to take part in the charity run.

questions.text: While the director ------- the presentation, the power went out.
questions.expl: Hành động đang diễn ra trong quá khứ dùng was giving.

questions.text: When the auditor arrived, the team ------- the financial statements.
questions.expl: Hành động đang diễn ra dùng were reviewing.

grammar.concept: Subject-Verb Agreement (Sự hòa hợp Chủ ngữ và Động từ)
grammar.trap: Chủ ngữ danh từ số ít (The office, The system) động từ to-be quá khứ là was, không dùng were.

vocab.example: The board allocated  to customer service technology.
The server has reached its storage capacity.
The new office furniture is stylish and durable.
She took the initiative to improve customer onboarding.
The backup servers are physically isolated.
We switched to a more reliable internet provider.
Software bugs must not recur in production.
The new process resulted in a 30% reduction in errors.
Support agents must stay on top of open tickets.
Replacement parts are kept in stock at all times.

questions.text: The regional office ------- closed yesterday for renovations.
questions.expl: The regional office là danh từ số ít ➔ was closed.

grammar.concept: Present Simple for Habitual Truths (Hiện tại đơn chỉ sự thật hiển nhiên)
grammar.trap: Chủ ngữ ngôi thứ 3 số ít động từ thêm s/es (The container holds, không dùng is holding).

vocab.example: We appreciate your prompt response to our inquiry.
The new campaign brought in thousands of new customers.
The company maintains a business-casual dress code.
Employees must adhere to the professional code of conduct.
The conference exposed our team to cutting-edge tools.
The keynote gave a glimpse into the future of AI.
The packaging is made of 100% recycled paper.
We are currently out of stock for this printer model.
The company replaced its outdated billing software.
It is standard business practice to sign an NDA.

questions.text: All warehouse personnel ------- wear protective gear at all times.
questions.expl: Sau modal verb must là động từ nguyên mẫu bare infinitive (must wear).

questions.text: Each standard shipping container ------- up to 20 metric tons.
questions.expl: Sự thật công suất dùng hiện tại đơn ngôi thứ 3: holds.

grammar.concept: Present Perfect with Number of Completed Items (Hiện tại hoàn thành chỉ số lượng)
grammar.trap: Khi nói về số lượng kết quả đã hoàn thành tính đến nay (written 5 reports) ➔ Dùng thì hoàn thành, không dùng tiếp diễn.

vocab.example: The seminar reinforced the importance of cybersecurity.
The agreement was verbally confirmed before signing.
Employees may connect personal devices to the guest Wi-Fi.
The new intranet facilitates internal communication.
A secure network is critical for corporate data.
Cloud services have gained immense popularity.
The onboarding process takes about three days.
We replaced the old servers with high-speed SSDs.
AI is driving a revolution in office productivity.
The company reported a sharp increase in quarterly revenue.

questions.text: So far this month, our technical team ------- over fifty support tickets.
questions.expl: Có cụm so far this month chỉ số lượng kết quả hoàn thành ➔ has resolved.
